args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production (error rate 18%, unhealthy) after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks (unhealthy, 18% error rate) after the latest deploy of v2.3.1.

**Actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Current status showed v2.3.1 deployed to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and unhealthy. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback and the need to investigate the v2.3.1 regression.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is back on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.2%.
